div.div:
غَشْيَةٌ an inf. n. of the verb in the phrase غُشِىَ عَلَيْهِ, (S, Mgh,) or the subst, thereof, (K,) or the inf. n. un. thereof [signifying A swoon]. (Msb.) See 1, last sentence. ―
-b2- غَشْيَةُ المَوْتِ is The clouding (lit. covering) of the understanding that befalls a man on the occasion of death. (TA.) ―
-b3- And غَشْيَةُ حُمَّى signifies A touch, or slight attack, of fever. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
